scripts.test:integration: JOBSEEKER_TEST_MODE=integration tsx -e "import { validateTestDatabaseUrl, REQUIRED_INTEGRATION_SUITES, evaluateIntegrationGateReport } from './src/lib/services/testDatabaseSecurity'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; if (process.env.JOBSEEKER_TEST_MODE !== 'integration') { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED] Execution mode violation: JOBSEEKER_TEST_MODE=integration required.'); process.exit(1); } if ('JOBSEEKER_GATE_SYNTHETIC_REPORT' in process.env || 'JOBSEEKER_GATE_SYNTHETIC_REPORT_FILE' in process.env || process.env.JOBSEEKER_GATE_SYNTHETIC_REPORT !== undefined || process.env.JOBSEEKER_GATE_SYNTHETIC_REPORT_FILE !== undefined) { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED INTEGRATION GATE] Security violation: Synthetic report injection variables are strictly prohibited in canonical integration execution.'); process.exit(1); } const res = validateTestDatabaseUrl(process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL); if (!res.valid) { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED INTEGRATION GATE] Target validation failed: ' + res.error + ' (' + res.code + ')'); process.exit(1); } for (const s of REQUIRED_INTEGRATION_SUITES) { if (!fs.existsSync(s)) { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED] Required suite undiscovered on disk: ' + s); process.exit(1); } } try { const out = execSync('npx vitest run ' + REQUIRED_INTEGRATION_SUITES.join(' ') + ' --reporter=json', { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: { ...process.env, JOBSEEKER_TEST_MODE: 'integration' }, encoding: 'utf-8' }); const gateRes = evaluateIntegrationGateReport(JSON.parse(out), REQUIRED_INTEGRATION_SUITES); if (!gateRes.valid) { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED INTEGRATION GATE] ' + gateRes.error + ' (' + gateRes.code + ')'); process.exit(1); } console.log('[INTEGRATION GATE PASSED] All required suites verified.'); } catch (e) { console.error('[FAIL-CLOSED] Integration verification failed: ' + (e.stderr || e.message)); process.exit(1); }"
